title: Power Rankings: Spurs hold off Celtics at No. 1
heading: 2010-11 Power Rankings: Week 14
author: Marc Stein

rankings.summaryHtml: If you're a Spurs fan who believes in omens, savor this while waiting for the next home game on Feb. 23: Six of the previous seven teams to win 40 games as fast as San Antonio just did went on to win the whole thing.

rankings.summaryHtml: Never overestimate one regular-season game. I'd be lying, however, if I didn't admit to hearing voices whisper Doc's trusty line about how his "A" starting five has never lost a series after what the Celts just did in L.A.

rankings.summaryHtml: Multiple ulcers for D-Rose. Only six games out of 47 with a full complement of big men. Yet somehow that adds up to a 25-6 record since Dec. 4, when a heavy loss to Orlando and an L in Boston left the Bulls at a humble 9-8.

rankings.summaryHtml: For all the justified glee about Ryan Anderson's play as the new Rashard Lewis, Orlando is down a spot to No. 4 in the East since the big trades ... with Arenas averaging 8.5 ppg as a Magician on 36.7 percent shooting.

rankings.summaryHtml: Dear KD: Please resist any urge to be your usual impeccable self and retract what you said about Bosh after Sunday's showdown. Let it sit. We all loved this: "Lot of fake tough guys in this league and he's one of them."

rankings.summaryHtml: Remember all those second-half comebacks and the 15-5 start? The Jazz need a teamwide resurrection now after a 1-6 skid, with D-Will (wrist) ailing and Jefferson/Millsap not clicking any better than Jefferson/Love did.
